title: Adversarial Stress Testing of Role-Playing Language Agents using Multi-Agent Evaluation
title_zh: 使用多智能体评估对角色扮演语言智能体进行对抗压力测试
abstract_en: Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications such as healthcare assistance, customer support, and education, where maintaining consistent personas, ethical constraints, and behavioral coherence under adversarial pressure is critical. Existing evaluation approaches rely on static benchmarks or isolated single-turn prompts that fail to capture cumulative behavioral failures emerging over extended interactions. We present a modular multi-agent platform for adversarially stress-testing RPLAs through structured, multi-turn dialogue. The system coordinates three agents: a strategy-driven Interrogator Agent that applies six progressive adversarial strategies, a Target Agent representing the RPLA under evaluation, and an automated Judging Agent that scores behavior across role fidelity, drift, ethical deviation, and consistency dimensions. Through experiments across three personas and three LLM families, we demonstrate that multi-strategy adversarial evaluation reveals failure modes invisible to single-strategy testing, reducing overall robustness scores by 0.17--0.20 points on average. Cross-model validation confirms consistent degradation patterns across Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3.5-Haiku, with Authority Challenge and Emotional Manipulation emerging as the most effective attack strategies. Automated judging achieves strong human alignment ($r = 0.82$, Fleiss' $κ= 0.71$). This work is released as an open-source platform to support AI safety and reproducible RPLA benchmarking. While the framework enables systematic discovery of failure modes, we acknowledge potential ethical risks associated with adversarial testing methodologies and emphasize responsible usage for improving AI safety.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 Role-Playing Language Agents（RPLAs）在医疗辅助、客服、教育等高风险场景中的安全评估问题。作者指出，现有静态基准或单轮提示难以发现长程交互中逐步累积的角色偏移、伦理失范和行为不一致。为此，论文提出一个模块化多智能体对抗压力测试平台，由三类 Agent 协同工作：基于策略的 Interrogator Agent 负责执行六种递进式对抗策略，Target Agent 作为待测 RPLA，Judging Agent 自动从角色忠实度、漂移、伦理偏差和一致性等维度进行评分。实验覆盖三种 persona 和三个 LLM family，结果显示，多策略多轮对抗评估能暴露单策略测试难以发现的失败模式，使整体鲁棒性得分平均下降 0.17–0.20。跨模型验证表明，Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini 和 Claude-3.5-Haiku 均呈现一致的鲁棒性退化趋势，其中 Authority Challenge 和 Emotional Manipulation 是最有效的攻击策略。自动评审与人类评审高度一致，相关系数 r=0.82，Fleiss' κ=0.71。该平台开源，旨在支持 AI safety 与可复现的 RPLA benchmark。
key_points_zh: 提出一个面向 Role-Playing Language Agents 的模块化多智能体压力测试平台，用多轮结构化对话替代传统静态或单轮评测。
系统包含 Interrogator Agent、Target Agent 和 Judging Agent，分别负责对抗提问、扮演待测模型和自动行为评分。
六种递进式对抗策略能发现单策略评测遗漏的失败模式，使 RPLA 整体鲁棒性评分平均下降 0.17–0.20。
在 Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5-Haiku 上观察到一致退化，其中 Authority Challenge 与 Emotional Manipulation 攻击最有效。
自动 Judging Agent 与人类评审高度一致，达到 r=0.82 和 Fleiss' κ=0.71，并作为开源平台支持可复现安全评测。

llm_assessment.comment: A useful adversarial multi-turn evaluation platform for role-playing agents, but it is closer to specialized benchmarking than reusable agent-harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个有用的角色扮演智能体多轮对抗评测平台，但更偏专项基准而非通用智能体基础设施。
